data.narrative:
Furno Materials is a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Gurinder Nagra that has raised $11M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comp universe includes nine private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and one public comparable (Linamar, ticker LNZA), though none provide sufficient Stage-matched or adjacent-stage datapoints for reliable peer-median benchmarking.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method. Using the $11M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied value of $28M. This represents the single quantitative anchor available given the scarcity of narrowly-comparable peer transactions at Furno's stage and sector intersection.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, with a median point of $28M. This range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression estimate. The chief uncertainty is the absence of recent, Stage-matched comparable transactions in Climate & Energy; broader sector peers do exist but operate at different development phases or scale. Any refinement would require either transaction data from similar-stage climate tech companies or material updates to Furno's revenue, burn, or technical milestones.
